checks.note: Statement excerpt, proposition, conditions, rationale and outcome (historical_observation, not_applicable, unresolved) are all fine. The e1 citation excerpt is wrong: it shows only "$11 billion next year." That drops "Anthropic has projected it will burn about $11 billion this year and", so the quote no longer names the company, the projection or the 2026 figure. Use the full sentence. Publisher, dates and relation are correct.

Excerpt is verbatim. Proposition keeps his sourcing, the conditional 'would', the $11.7bn annualised figure and the 71%. The note about reproductions matches the sources the packet considered. e1 excerpt, publisher, dates (2026-03-31 / 2026-04-29) and context relation are right. Minor point: the consistent-quarter condition really applies to the ~$4.14bn quarterly figure, not to the derived run rate, but it is not material.

Excerpt, proposition, 'I'd argue' condition and outcome (causal_assessment, not_applicable, unresolved) are fine. The e2 citation excerpt is just the word "substantial", which says nothing. It should quote the commitments/upfront-payments sentence. The ambiguity flag it comes from refers to the claim itself, not any agreement. The e1 excerpt is truncated but acceptable.
